title: Several owned things: Nämä ovat …
focus: Drop plural -t before the owner ending; use Nämä ovat for several things.
targetSkills: Plural possessed nouns in ownership sentences

exercises.prompt: Complete “These are our cars.” Nämä ovat meidän ___. Use auto (“car”), autot (“cars”), and -mme.
exercises.explanation: Remove plural -t before the owner ending: autot + -mme gives automme. Nämä ovat still shows several things.
requiredSkills: Plural possessed nouns in ownership sentences
exercises.targetSkill: Plural possessed nouns in ownership sentences
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural possessed nouns in ownership sentences: form or meaning confused

sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative + agreeing olla + optional owner pronoun + possessed noun

parts.formation: Nämä is the plural of tämä: several things.
Use ovat with several things, independently of how many people own them.
Meidän is the personal owner form of me; it selects -mme.
autot (“cars”) loses its plural -t before -mme: auto + -mme = automme.

optionFeedback.autotmme: The plural -t disappears before a possessive suffix; use automme.
optionFeedback.autot: This personal owner phrase needs its supplied ending -mme; use automme.
optionFeedback.autoni: Keep the supplied ending -mme for meidän; use automme.

parts.formation: Nämä is the plural of tämä: several things.

answerDiagnostics.explanation: Drop the noun’s plural -t before -mme: use talomme.
